svg.title: mutaspec
svg.desc: mutaspec: plant bugs and see which ones your tests catch. A Mutant Set of git patches runs in git worktrees against your unit, integration, API and UI test suites. Each Mutant is Killed or Survived, and you get a Mutation Score for each level. For a Survived Mutant, an agent suggests what to test. You write the tests, then run the next round against the same Mutants.
